findings.description: The async exit method discards the exception raised inside the context by always passing `None` to `__exit__`. It must forward `exc_type`, `exc_value`, and `traceback` so the attempt records the failure.
findings.rationale: When an `async with attempt:` body raises a retryable exception, this call makes `__exit__` record a successful `None` result instead of the exception. The original exception then propagates out of the context, bypassing the retry handling and terminating the operation on its first failed attempt.
